page: Amazon Web Services m8id.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6975P-C processors running at 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 30 Gbps.

The Intel Xeon processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated matrix operations. In performance benchmarks, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 25% for multi-core stress-ng tests and the top 10% for Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. Software compilation with Clang, image processing, and text processing also rank in the top 10% tier. However, single-core stress-ng performance and large-block memory write bandwidth remain in the average category.

With its integrated 3800 GB NVMe SSD storage and 30 Gbps network baseline, the instance delivers top-tier static web serving throughput. Database operations and Redis SET operations both perform in the top 25% tier. For machine learning workloads, the instance achieves top 10% performance in prompt processing for large 70B LLM models, though text generation speed for the same large model drops to the average tier. This hardware profile is suited for database hosting, static web serving, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
